descriptionPlain:
Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status. 
 
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
 
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
 
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!


The Team: 
You will be a member of our Delivery Services team, which includes all of the Consultants, Engineers & Architects that deliver tailored workforce management solutions to global brands in hospitality, retail and healthcare. Our key focus is designing and delivering transformative solutions that help our customers grow their businesses into thriving workplaces. As a team we value the diverse perspectives and experiences each team member brings to the table and are looking for individuals who are passionate about having a huge part in building a best in class experience for our customers. 
The Role: 
As a Lead Implementation Consultant - Payroll, you’ll leverage your technical background to develop tailored solutions for our enterprise customers. You’ll own the delivery lifecycle for new and existing implementations, developing strong relationships that set our customers up for success. You’ll support the team with local internal initiatives and be given time to innovate and own areas of process improvement
Manage the end-to-end delivery and implementation of complex Payroll projects for Deputy’s largest enterprise customers.

lists.content:
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing best practices, thought leadership and identifying areas of opportunity throughout the payroll implementation process
  • Mentor and support junior team members on payroll implementation best practices, technical nuances, and customer engagement strategies to build overall team capability and confidence
  • Validate customer requirements discovered in the sales process through technical workshops and informational sessions with operational stakeholders
  • Define and communicate project plans with clearly defined timelines and deliverables
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects to design custom solutions as needed to fulfil customer requirements
  • Engage CX Engineers and delivery partners to develop and deliver custom work in line with customer’s requirements and project timelines
  • Interpret and map customer’s business structure to the Deputy platform, optimising for ease of use and performance
  • Proactively communicate with internal and external stakeholders regarding status updates, risks, and overall project health
  • Take a train-the-trainer approach, equipping customer with training sessions and materials to insure continued success
  • Collaborate with Support and Success teams to document the configuration, custom solutions, and key stakeholders from the account, insuring a smooth transition from Implementation into longer-term support

• Proven ability to understand, define, and document deliverables, including but not limited to: requirements specifications, gap analysis, use case scenarios, acceptance testing, process maps, and data flow diagrams
  • Must have strong understanding of and experience with implementation cycles for both internally and externally managed initiatives
  • Solid history of establishing and meeting work schedules with limited time frames and under tight deadlines
  • Ability to understand and relate to both technical and non-technical project team members
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS applications
  • 7+ Years of professional experience in delivery, implementation, or project management with at least 3 of those as a payroll implementation specialist

The Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Professional Services Operations Coordinator to support the successful delivery of Professional Services engagements. This role partners cross-functionally to coordinate operational workflows, maintain project systems, prepare operational reporting, and support consistent execution of service delivery processes across the organization. The successful applicant will be someone who excels at maintaining order, enjoys ensuring team efficiency, and is dedicated to managing precise operational processes and data.

lists.content:
• Collaboration on Cross-Functional Delivery: Coordinate with departments including Sales, Implementation, Finance, and RevOps to manage operational tasks that support project success, such as routing projects, provisioning, and customer transition management.

  • Sales-to-Implementation Readiness: Manage the handover of customers from the sales team to the delivery phase, ensuring all contractual obligations and deliverables are compliant before the project starts.

  • Implementation-to-Success Handovers: Ensure a complete and consistent handover of implementation projects to Customer Success, including an audit of the implementation consultant's project closeout activities. 

  • Management of Operational Systems: Oversee the administration of Professional Services tools, such as Toggl and Asana, ensuring precise data entry and process compliance through project provisioning, template upkeep, user permissions management, and the systematic archiving of finished work.

  • Operational Reporting: Prepare recurring operational reports and dashboards for Professional Services leadership, supporting visibility into delivery performance, capacity, utilization, backlog, and project health.

  • Operational Standards & Documentation: Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and operational playbooks to support consistent execution across the Professional Services organization.

  • Financial Operations Support: Support Professional Services operations by maintaining metrics tracking and KPI reporting.

  • Operational Automation & Tool Support: Utilize AI-enabled tools, workflow automations, and platform integrations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support accurate operational data.

  • Data Quality Management: Audit operational data, project documentation, and delivery readiness across systems, coordinating timely corrections with appropriate stakeholders to maintain accurate project information and compliance with established standards.

• 3–5 years of experience in Professional Services Operations, Delivery Operations, Project Coordination, or a similar operational support role within a SaaS or technology organization.

  • Expertise in managing and utilizing CRM and Project Management software, particularly Salesforce, Toggl, Asana, and any PSA systems.

  • Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel, including maintaining capacity trackers, SLA reporting, and operational reporting.

  • Self-starter capable of managing routine operational tasks with high autonomy, ensuring rigorous data integrity and meeting all deadlines.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities to engage with various stakeholders and uphold data compliance standards across the organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and operational discipline.

  • Experience preparing operational reports and maintaining data used to support leadership decision-making.

lists.content:

  • Run your own qualification calls with prospects, helping to determine if they should be passed to AEs for the next stage

  • Demonstrate attentive listening skills when understanding customer requirements and articulate how we can meet those needs better than other solutions

  • Take rigorous notes and maintain data cleanliness in the CRM to ensure quality handoff to AEs

  • Consistently meet established quota targets that will contribute to the company's revenue growth.

  • Team player and demonstrated ability to work well in a collaborative environment

  • Excellent time management skills and ability to juggle multiple priorities 

  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills 

  • Excellent phone presence and interpersonal communication skills, both written and oral

  • A love for making an impact and working with a team to hit key goals and metrics 

  • Passion and curiosity around technology with the ability to break  comprehend and articulate value points to customers 

  • Must thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

  • Startup and/or people tech experience is a plus!

lists.content:
• Proactively source, engage and qualify strategic prospects in target segments and industries to generate pipeline and create qualified opportunities for our AMER sales team 
  • Engage with potential clients through various communication channels such as calls, emails, LinkedIn, texts and live chat platforms aimed at creating new business opportunities
  • Run your own qualification calls with prospects, helping to determine if they should be passed to AEs for the next stage
  • Demonstrate attentive listening skills when understanding customer requirements and articulate how we can meet those needs better than other solutions
  • Take rigorous notes and maintain data cleanliness in the CRM to ensure quality handoff to AEs
  • Consistently meet established quota targets that will contribute to the company's revenue growth.

  • Excellent time management skills and ability to juggle multiple priorities 
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills 
  • Excellent phone presence and interpersonal communication skills
  • A love for making an impact and working with a team to hit key goals and metrics 
  • Passion and curiosity around technology, with the ability to comprehend and articulate value points to customers 
  • Naturally curious individual who wants to understand the why behind the why
  • Must thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and other sales enablement tools (i.e. Outreach, Sales Navigator, Cognism)
  • Startup and/or people tech experience is a plus!

We’re looking for a Senior Engineer to help own, shape and build our design system with a strong emphasis on AI-native workflows. This role sits within the design function and focuses on translating design into code while enabling AI to meaningfully participate in that process. 
 
The role also explicitly includes designer enablement — creating low-friction workflows, templates and coaching so designers can rapidly prototype and become confident “design-and-build” prototypers. You will define how the design system is structured so it can power AI-driven design-to-code workflows, and ensure designs can be efficiently generated, validated and maintained in code.

We’re looking for a Senior Engineer to help own, shape and build our design system with a strong emphasis on AI-native workflows. This role sits within the design function and focuses on translating design into code while enabling AI to meaningfully participate in that process. 
 
The role also explicitly includes designer enablement — creating low-friction workflows, templates and coaching so designers can rapidly prototype and become confident “design-and-build” prototypers. You will define how the design system is structured so it can power AI-driven design-to-code workflows, and ensure designs can be efficiently generated, validated and maintained in code.

lists.content:
Design-to-Code Execution (AI-Enhanced)

  • Build and maintain production-ready UI components that accurately reflect design intent

  • Use AI tools to accelerate implementation, iteration, and refinement of components

  • Validate AI-generated outputs to ensure quality, accessibility, and consistency

    • AI-Driven Design System Enablement

    • Shape the design system (tokens, components, patterns) to be machine-readable and AI-friendly

    • Contribute to workflows that enable design-to-code generation using AI, and ensure components include the metadata AI needs to generate and validate code.

    • Identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort in component creation and maintenance, including using AI to scaffold components, run linting, generate tests and produce documentation.

      • Embedded Collaboration with Design

      • Act as a core member of the design team, participating in critiques and explorations

      • Provide technical perspective during design to ensure outputs are scalable and implementable

      • Help designers understand how their work can better support AI-driven development

        • Tooling & Workflow Innovation

        • Improve integration between design tools (e.g., Figma) and engineering outputs

        • Use AI to generate documentation, specs, and component usage guidelines

        • Explore AI-assisted approaches to testing (visual regression, accessibility) and validation

        • Prototype and experiment with new AI-driven workflows for design systems

          • Consistency, Quality & Accessibility

          • Ensure high fidelity between design and implementation

          • Maintain accessibility and inclusive design standards across components

          • Contribute to shared standards that improve system consistency across design and code

            • Adoption & Advocacy

            • Create documentation and examples that serve both designers and engineers

            • Support teams in using the design system effectively

            • Advocate for workflows that improve speed without compromising qualit

              • A design system that can be effectively leveraged by AI for generation, validation, and maintenance

              • Faster iteration from design to production through AI-assisted workflows

              • High fidelity between design intent and shipped UI, even with AI in the loop

              • Increased efficiency for both designers and engineers using the system

• ~4–6 years of experience in front-end engineering, design engineering and design systems

  • Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience building UI components in modern frameworks (Vue, React, etc.)

  • Strong design sensibility and attention to detail (visual and interaction)

  • Experience working closely with design tools (e.g., Figma, tokens, variants)

  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted design and development workflows

  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive design practices

  • Familiarity with design tokens and system architecture across design and code

  • Ability to operate fluently between design and engineering contexts
